message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the long‑weekend periods in Canada for 2023 (based on the federal holidays that fall on a weekday and create a three‑day stretch):

| Long‑Weekend Period | Holiday(s) Involved | Notes |
|---------------------|---------------------|-------|
| **April 7–9** | Good Friday (April 7) | Good Friday is a statutory holiday in most provinces, giving you Friday‑Saturday‑Sunday off. |
| **November 10–12** | Remembrance Day (November 11) | Remembrance Day is a federal holiday; the long weekend runs Thursday‑Friday‑Saturday. |
| **December 25–27** | Christmas Day (Dec 25) & Boxing Day (Dec 26) | Both holidays are observed federally, so you get Monday‑Tuesday‑Wednesday off. |

> **Quick tip:** If you’re planning trips, the best long‑weekend windows are the ones that give you a full three‑day break (e.g., the Good Friday weekend). The other two are still great for a short getaway, especially if you can combine the holiday with a nearby destination.

Feel free to plug these dates into your holiday‑planning app!
